points.description: Closed-loop poles: substitutes the control law to get s² + 4s + 8 = 0 (i.e. θ̈ + (a+bk2)θ̇ + (c+bk1)θ = bN_ff r) and finds poles s = −2 ± 2j. Equivalent forms (−2 ± j2) accepted.

levels.says: Correct closed-loop characteristic equation s²+4s+8=0 but poles wrong or not found.

points.description: N_ff = 8, obtained from a stated DC-gain condition (e.g. set derivatives to zero or final value: θss/r = bN_ff/(c+bk1) = N_ff/8 = 1). A bare value 8 with no DC-gain condition shown does not earn full marks.

levels.says: Correct DC-gain expression N_ff/8 (or b N_ff/(c+bk1)) stated but final N_ff wrong, or N_ff = 8 given without showing the DC-gain condition.

rubric.notes: Full marks for poles −2 ± 2j and N_ff = 8 justified by a DC-gain condition. Part marks as per levels for correct intermediate equation or DC-gain expression with a later error. No marks for the wrong closed-loop equation, e.g. ignoring the gravity term c.
rubric.answer_key: Closed loop: θ̈ + (a+bk2)θ̇ + (c+bk1)θ = bN_ff r → θ̈ + 4θ̇ + 8θ = N_ff r. Characteristic: s²+4s+8=0 → s = −2 ± 2j. DC gain (derivatives zero): θss = N_ff r/8, so unity gain requires N_ff = 8.
